warnings.message: pnpm: minimumReleaseAgeExclude in pnpm-workspace.yaml (line 4) exempts react from the release-age delay, but cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json does not; depcurfew apply comments it out, so pnpm delays it like every other package
warnings.fix: To keep the exception, add "react" to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again
